title: CallRecord
description: Native payload of the call channel (112). This is what the HappyRobot voice-ingest workflow receives, and the ONLY input contract for calls at all three levels: level 1, the simulator POSTs this JSON; level 2, a HappyRobot voice agent role-playing a citizen calls the inbound agent, which produces this record; level 3, a live human calls during the demo, same. The ingest workflow extracts claims and location and POSTs a normalized signal to the kernel. No claims, no trust, no resolved zone here: perception is the workflow's job.

id.description: Call id (sig-* id of the underlying scripted signal, so extraction can be scored against ground truth).

caller.description: Who is calling, as the phone system would see it.

gps.description: Handset location if the emergency call carries AML/GPS data. Absent otherwise.

transcript.description: What the caller said, transcribed. At level 1 the simulator provides it; at levels 2-3 the voice agent transcribes the real audio.

persona.description: Level 2 readiness: the citizen role for a voice agent to play. Present in simulator output only as a passthrough from the timeline; real calls never carry it. Ingest workflows must ignore it.

who.description: Short character description (vecina de Paiporta, 60 anos, muy nerviosa).

unknowns.description: Things the caller cannot answer, so the voice agent stays realistic under questioning.
